written.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify before US House committees on Dec 1
written.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will appear before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China Select Committees on Dec 1. The hearing follows his resignation amid a scandal involving an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

written.headline: Genesis AI raises $500 million Series A at $3.5 billion valuation
written.summary: Genesis AI, a Paris‑based robot maker, announced a $500 million Series A round valuing the company at $3.5 billion. The funding will support expanding computing infrastructure, robot production and hiring.

written.headline: Anthropic grants METR employee-level access to its AI models and safety tools
written.summary: Anthropic gave six METR researchers company laptops, office space and internal tool access to evaluate its frontier AI models, safety practices and risk management.

written.headline: AI in gaming: experts warn against single-field narrative
written.summary: Ethan Mollick posted on Bluesky that the narrative that games will be the only field where humans write code unassisted is wrong. He argues that this push from press and fans misses an opportunity to guide AI usage to empower workers and help gaming thrive.
